answer_raw:
**Florianópolis** offers the greatest stretch for your money, as a single person can live comfortably there for roughly **$1,500 per month** (as of June 2026) [1].

I didn't find cost of living or rent specifics for Medellín, so you should check local expat forums or Numbeo for those current figures.

For the available comparisons:

**Florianópolis** — A one-bedroom in a good area costs between **R$2,500 and R$3,800** (as of 2026) [3], while a downtown one-bedroom runs approximately **R$3,550** (as of June 2026) [1]. Total monthly living costs for one person, including food and transport, sit around **R$8,093 (~$1,500)** (as of June 2026) [1].

**Lisbon** — Rent is significantly higher here, as Florianópolis rent prices are **57.7% lower** than in Lisbon (undated) [2]. The cost of living in Florianópolis is **43.4% lower** than in Lisbon when including rent (undated) [2].

**Medellín** — Data was not provided for this city.
